rule: Evaluate every condition on a source line before executing any state-changing, presentation, or branch operation from that line.
condition_order: source sequence among conditions with short-circuit on first failure
execution_order: source sequence among non-condition operations after successful preflight
reason: Four source lines encode prerequisites after item, message, or reward operations.
Literal token-by-token execution could consume or grant state before a later prerequisite fails.
Atomic preflight preserves every directive and prevents partial quest-state corruption.
fallback: Abort the entire clause without mutation when a condition, reference, or target cannot be evaluated.
save_world_state_impact: Prevents partial inventory, ability, experience, alignment, summon, teleport, and quest-flag mutations.
tests: All 182 quest-stage scripts compile into source-line clauses.
All 490 clauses preserve non-condition source order.
Every source-line condition appears in preflight, including four late-position condition clauses.
